decided_by: the owner (selection widened before any labelling); rules written by Claude Code
source: MTSamples CSV (4,999 rows) at the owner's local path, outside the repository; note text never enters git

inclusion.skin_pathology: a pathology specialty and the text matches cdm.extract.SKIN
inclusion.lesion_mention_other_specialty: any other specialty and the text matches cdm.extract.LESION: a specific skin-lesion diagnosis (melanoma, basal cell carcinoma, cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, keratoacanthoma, nevus, seborrheic or actinic keratosis, dermatofibroma, cherry angioma, pyogenic granuloma, lentigo, skin cancer), a skin biopsy, or a skin, cutaneous or pigmented lesion named as such
inclusion.negative_controls: notes whose only match is a phrase like 'no skin lesions' (review-of-systems templates) are kept on purpose: the expected labels are empty, which tests false positives
inclusion.excluded: incidental skin words (for example 'the skin was closed'), which the earlier SKIN pattern matched, and empty transcriptions; duplicate texts count once (note ID is a hash of the text)

split.rule: notes ordered by note ID; the first 10% are development (prompt design), the rest scoring; fixed before any prompt runs

superseded: a first sheet of 30 notes (Dermatology plus skin pathology only, 20% development), never labelled, kept outside the repository
